total_model.summary: Model projects 45.4 total points (BUF 30, MIA 15). Biggest factors: Divisional game (lowers total 0.8), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.7), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
